title: Public Data Allowlist — Ix-findings knowledge explorer (GitHub Pages projection)
principle: Allowlist by default. Only fields explicitly listed below may be published. Unknown or potentially private information is EXCLUDED unless listed.

meta.note: meta.dataFreshness may contain 'BLOCKED — no source access' strings (public status statement, allowed).

findings.note: Finding prose is public investigation output.

evidence.note: detail must not contain local paths or secrets; build step filters repository names only.

graph.note: node 'note'/'file' fields EXCLUDED by default (may contain local paths). url allowed only for public github.com URLs (system-compass private URLs stripped by build step).

worktrees.note: local filesystem paths — NEVER publish. Entity count may still be reported in meta.

excludes: PRIVATE urls unless access field marks them

externalMirror.note: Public GitHub source snapshots and separate Ix-findings analysis; GitHub remains authoritative. Recursively sanitized for secrets and local paths.

sysCompass.note: contains access/blocker narrative; publish only meta-level status instead.

manifest.note: raw manifest embeds local_paths + execution constraints — NEVER publish the raw object. Only meta counters are used.

labeling.siteLabel: SNAPSHOT — generated from canonical investigation data; not a live view of GitHub state.
